Driver: `self` is a class instance whose `rel.g` is a `ReadLog` (real Graph recording the (subject, predicate) of each pattern the REGION asks; the object position is dropped because `o in g[s:p]` scans (s, p, None) while the island's existence test asks (s, p, o)); the log and the collaborators' calls are the `reads` attribute of `self`, compared as a mutation. 16 calls: a frame with an origin / with none / with two (first read wins) / a non-Frame with an origin (AssertionError) / origin under another predicate / a Point / unknown / empty graph; reference point given as positional or keyword (no read), None, an empty URIRef and 0 (falsy: defaulted), 'x' (truthy: kept); angular/linear arguments passed through.
